TextView.android:text:
OneCall ek fully offline app hai. Is app ka koi bhi data internet pe nahi jaata.

Yeh app aapke phone aur ek doosre Bluetooth device ke beech kaam karta hai — bina kisi server ke, bina internet ke.

Koi analytics nahi. Koi telemetry nahi. Koi data collection nahi.

Bluetooth pairing sirf aapke local devices ke beech hoti hai. Call history sirf aapke device ke local database mein save hoti hai.

App band karne ke baad session history automatically delete ho jaati hai (secondary device pe).
